fields.name: thermal_conductivity_coefficient
fields.rationale: The thermal conductivity coefficient (lambda-value) is crucial for understanding the insulation's effectiveness in preventing heat transfer.

fields.name: water_vapour_resistance
fields.rationale: High resistance to water vapour transmission is a key property for insulation materials to prevent moisture ingress and potential corrosion.
evidence: extremely high resistance to water vapour transmission

fields.name: production_process
fields.rationale: The production process (continuous or discontinuous) affects the material properties and application suitability of the insulation product.
evidence: pressureless, continuous and discontinuous production process
inference_basis: Continuous and discontinuous processes imply different manufacturing techniques and material characteristics.
